fix: Plan components O4 (D8) and O5 (D9), spec sections 7 and 8. RunPool becomes the scheduler under the orchestrator: it asks admission for the next todo, runs FreshenSpecs before launch, and publishes each transition on the loop channel. Each lane holds a lease with a heartbeat from its own events and a deadline; past the deadline it stops through its own process group and releases its item.
